next.reason: 1985: "The NEXT phrase must be specified for files in dynamic access mode when records are to be retrieved sequentially."; 2023: "ACCESS MODE DYNAMIC ... the NEXT phrase is implied if any of the following phrases is specified: ADVANCING, AT END, or NOT AT END.". 1985 requires an explicit NEXT for a sequential read in dynamic mode. 2023 implies NEXT when ADVANCING or AT END/NOT AT END is given, and PREVIOUS also gives a sequential read.
